content: REPLACE THIS. One entry per letter, alternating writers. Each needs at least 250 words to match what the app asks of a real letter — a shorter one will look wrong next to the counter in the compose screen. Keep the voice consistent with whoever is writing: Ryland is a junior-high science teacher who explains things to keep himself calm, and who counts. Rocky is precise, literal, warm in a way that arrives sideways, and does not use contractions.

REPLACE THIS TOO. The demo reads best when the letters answer each other — a question in one picked up in the next, a running thread across the six. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD and should alternate so the archive shows a real back-and-forth rather than two monologues.
